name: sdlc-autonomous-pipeline
description: Fully autonomous variant of the 16-agent traceable SDLC pipeline. Every gate — including the 8 judgment gates (Module, Architecture, Business Requirements, Impact Analysis, Tech Reqs/ER Model, Security & Performance, Monitoring, Deploy Docs) — is self-certified by a role-based reviewer agent instead of a named human, driven end to end by a single orchestrator command. This trades away the human-accountability guarantee of the companion plugin (sdlc-traceable-pipeline) for genuine start-to-finish autonomy. See README.md for the explicit risk disclosure per gate before using this on anything beyond a trial run.
author: Internal Engineering
